[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Choose each Task Link's outcome while closing a Pomodoro with [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]=x<N>!<M>[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`=x<N>`, `=x!<M>`, and `=x<N>!<M>` close the running Pomodoro and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]decide, by number, which of its Task Links stay in progress, which [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]are deferred, and which are completed and struck. This does in one [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]capture what the user does by hand before Ctrl+Enter: append `#` to[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]links that should not start, and transclude links whose tasks are [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]finished. Every close stays atomic. A mistyped list gets a precise [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]diagnostic. Plain `=x` keeps working byte for byte as it does [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]today. `bob capture` output and the Bob Mac Capture close card show[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a number badge on every Task Link and the outcome each one will [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]get, so choosing the numbers is easy.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
